node.title: Re: how to grep from a log file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: You can refer to your own post [id://11131411] for the correct syntax (as well as [doc://grep|the documentation], of course). Also, you'll need to actually read the lines from the file, as you appear to be doing in that post with your utils::getFileContents() function. See also [doc://perlintro#Files-and-I/O|"Files and I/O" in perlintro].
